acts of ritual employment; object of ācaret

items.question: What kind of practitioner is qualified to perform the prescribed ritual applications?
premises: The ritual applications are to be performed.
The performer is designated as a mantra-practitioner.
The performer is further characterized as wise.
items.inference: Only a wise mantra-practitioner should carry out the prescribed ritual applications.
items.plain_english: The wise mantra-practitioner should perform the ritual applications.
